Name: Naruhodo's Carrots Mod - Deprecated
Author: NaruhodoAWrighto
Description:
[size=3]This mod is kinda useless with the 1.6 Update, so anyway.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/czsRulo.png[/img]
Adds Carrots and cooking recipes for it

Those Recipes are
[/size][list]
[*][b][size=3]Carrot Cake[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=3]Carrot Muffin[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=3]Carrot Fries[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=3]Carrot Smoothie[/size][/b]
[*][size=3]More Recipes will come soon[/size]
[/list][size=3]
You can buy carrot seeds on Pierre's Shop on Spring and Summer
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/S1Bjheo.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Install Json Assets[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Install Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0DU0eHq.png[/img]﻿
Works with any mod, at least as i'm aware
